headline: Kena Scars of Kosmora delayed to 2027
title: Kena Scars of Kosmora Delayed to 2027 | Ember Lab Sequel | Gaming News
video_script: Ember Lab has delayed Kena: Scars of Kosmora from twenty twenty six to twenty twenty seven. The studio announced it on October first on the PlayStation Blog, saying it needs a bit more time to polish the expanded game. It is coming to PlayStation five and PC, and no exact date has been set. Will the wait be worth it? Comment below!
description: Kena: Scars of Kosmora is delayed to 2027, announced October 1, 2026. Platforms PS5 and PC. Sources: Game Informer, Push Square.
joke: The little Rot are patient, so we will try to be too.
